g.text: PlayIT Use Case Diagram: the six functional modules of SRS v3.0 (§3.2)

g.id: cluster_Module 2: Speech Production and Tutoring (Say It)
g.text: Module 2: Speech Production and Tutoring (Say It)
Grey use cases with «planned» are in SRS v3.0 but not yet in the app
(SDD §2.0: LearnerModel, TelemetryLogger and CsvExportManager are planned).
Say It never removes hearts (FR-03.5). Hearts are lost and recovered only
in Find It and Blend It.
